## Load Packages and Data

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

library(janitor)

library(readxl)

library(palmerpenguins)

dogs <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckaoxvii/CIS-351-B-2026-Fall/refs/heads/main/Data/dogs.csv") |>
  clean_names()

earthquakes <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckaoxvii/CIS-351-B-2026-Fall/refs/heads/main/Data/earthquakes.csv") |>
  clean_names()

fastfood <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckaoxvii/CIS-351-B-2026-Fall/refs/heads/main/Data/fastfood.csv") |>
  clean_names()

water_quality <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckaoxvii/CIS-351-B-2026-Fall/refs/heads/main/Data/water_quality.csv") |>
  clean_names()

stalked_eyed_flies <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckaoxvii/CIS-351-B-2026-Fall/refs/heads/main/Data/stalked_eyed_flies.csv") |> 
  clean_names()

body_temp <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ckaoxvii/CIS-351-B-2026-Fall/refs/heads/main/Data/body_temp.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
```
